newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Members of WTO Helms-Burton dispute panel named.
newsitem.headline: Members of WTO Helms-Burton dispute panel named.

text.p: Switzerland, New Zealand and Singapore have been nominated by World Trade Organisation chief Renato Ruggiero to sit on the dispute panel that will rule on the European Union's complaint against the United States over its Helms-Burton Act, EU sources said on Thursday.

"The European Commission has been told that Arthur Dunkel of Switzerland, Ted Woodfield of New Zealand and Tommy Koh of Singapore will make up the panel," the source said. "An official announcement is expected soon".
The panel must rule within six months whether recent legislation passed by Washington to isolate Cuba contravenes world trade laws.

Among other things, the Helms Burton Act allows naturalised Americans to sue in U.S. courts foreign companies or individuals deemed to have profited from investments in propert confiscated by the Cuban government since the Communist revolution of 1959.
Ruggiero had to personally choose the panel after the U.S. and EU failed to agree its make-up between themselves.
